sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
In Solitaire TriPeaks Harvest, the core gameplay mechanics are simple yet engaging. The game is based on a classic solitaire puzzle game, where you need to remove cards in ascending order. However, the game has a twist - you'll be playing as a farmer, tasked with cultivating and harvesting crops. The gameplay is divided into levels, each with its own unique challenges and rewards. Your goal is to clear the puzzle levels by removing cards, while also growing and harvesting your crops.

The gameplay is easy to learn, but challenging to master. As you progress through the levels, the difficulty will increase, and you'll need to use your skills and strategies to clear the levels. The game also features a dynamic weather system, which affects the growth of your crops and the difficulty of the levels. For example, if it's raining, your crops will grow faster, but the levels will be more challenging.

One of the key features of Solitaire TriPeaks Harvest is its ability to adapt to your playing style. The game's difficulty level will adjust based on your performance, ensuring that the game is always challenging but never frustrating. This makes the game perfect for players of all skill levels, from casual players to seasoned gamers.
